purpose: Evidence sources for the Skills dimension of the five 2026-10-03 default-off CLI additions (docs/sakullla-workflow/2026-10-03-new-cli-adapters-default-off) and the six 2026-10-07 additions (docs/sakullla-workflow/2026-10-07-新增客户端完整支持与用量统计修复). The shared Skills pipeline imports packages into each adapter's native discovery directory; these entries record where each directory contract comes from.

zcode.format: Shared resource root ~/.zcode/skills; ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR relocates the whole data root. Delivered with the desktop adapter.

qoder.format: ~/.qoder/skills discovery directory; QODER_CONFIG_DIR relocates the config root.

kimi_code.format: Skills directory under the KIMI_CODE_HOME data root; locally verified 0.31.1 install.

deepseek.format: Ranked .dsh/skills directories; DSH_HOME relocates the data root.

codebuddy.format: Skills directory under the CODEBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR root; npm @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code 2.161.1 verified locally.

mimo_code.format: Project .mimocode/skills and personal ~/.config/mimocode/skills ({skill,skills}/**/SKILL.md); the open-standard ~/.agents/skills the CLI also reads stays with the product. Delivered with the 2026-10-07 workflow.

cline.format: Brand root ~/.cline/skills plus the open-standard project .agents/skills directory. CLI not installed locally; directory contract from source.

devin.ref: devin --help and config/transcript layout inspection on 3000.11.3
devin.limitation: No Skills directory documented in official docs or the inspected layout; the skills dimension stays absent with the descriptor reason recorded.

command_code.evidence: local verified install (npm command-code) + shipped bundle
command_code.format: Personal ~/.commandcode/skills and project .commandcode/skills (SKILL.md frontmatter); the open-standard ~/.agents/skills the CLI also reads stays with the product.

antigravity.evidence: remote isolated evidence run (Debian 13, docs/sakullla-workflow/2026-11-16-agy-full-adaptation) + builtin agy-customizations docs
antigravity.ref: scripts/agy-remote-evidence.mjs probe run and the signed-in /skills panel on the authorized 1.5.9 remote; report at docs/verification/remote-workflow/agy-1.5.9/
antigravity.format: Four discovery roots plus manifests: workspace .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; Global ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; Shared ~/.gemini/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; config root ~/.gemini/config/skills/<name>/SKILL.md — the product /skills panel states all three creation roots and labels the config root 'From ~/.gemini/config'. Non-standard directories are declared via .agents/skills.json {entries:[{path,include_only?,exclude?}],inherits:[]} (verified: a declared dir's skill appears with its dir-name source label and as a slash command; entries outside the workspace/repo root are skipped). Frontmatter requires name (must match the directory) and description. 1.3.1 note: only the Global and workspace roots were known then; the 1.5.9 run supersedes the layout evidence while keeping ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills valid. Delivered with the 1.5.9 sources task: the two brand roots stay the only write targets; Shared/config/builtin trees and skills.json-declared directories list as read-only discovery rows with their own source labels; directories without SKILL.md are not skills; enabling a package whose SKILL.md breaks the frontmatter contract is refused; same-name sources are marked (native precedence itself is the CLI's own and is not claimed); remote (SSH) inventory mirrors the Shared/config/builtin read-only roots, while workspace skills.json declarations are project-relative and stay local.
antigravity.limitation: The skills.json include_only/exclude semantics are inferred from the sanitized sample (skill-name filters, exact or * wildcard with the regex .* spelling normalized) — the shape is verified, the matching rule is not. Same-name precedence between sources was not observed on 1.5.9 and is deliberately not predicted. Windows/macOS layouts for 1.5.9 remain unverified (Linux evidence only).

kiro.ref: kiro.dev docs/skills (user ~/.kiro/skills and workspace .kiro/skills, SKILL.md frontmatter name must match the directory); cli.kiro.dev docs
kiro.limitation: Skills directories were not present on the local machine yet (feature not exercised there); delivery follows the official documented layout, directory creation happens on first use.

acceptanceLimits: Directory contracts verified from official documentation or desktop sources; no live skill execution acceptance performed.
Windows development host only; macOS/Linux not exercised.
Skill package install/update/remove flows through the shared pipeline are covered by the existing synthetic fixtures, not per-CLI live samples.

The 2026-10-07 six were checked on Windows only; skills are delivered for mimo_code/cline/command_code/antigravity and (since 2026-10-27, per official docs on the local 2.34.2 install) kiro; devin stays absent for lack of a documented directory contract.

antigravity was re-checked 2026-11-16 on Linux (Debian 13, agy 1.5.9) via an isolated remote evidence run: the /skills panel confirms the Global ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills, Shared ~/.gemini/skills and config ~/.gemini/config/skills roots plus workspace .agents/skills and skills.json declarations; Windows/macOS layouts for 1.5.9 remain unverified.
